reward_function_signature: def compute_reward(self, state, m_power, s_power, terminated):
design_principle: Sparse terminal reward for successful landing combined with dense shaping penalties during flight. Anti-hacking measures prevent sleep exploitation by requiring position verification at termination.

components.expected_effect: Encourages agent to move horizontally toward landing pad during flight
components.anti_hacking_role: Prevents boundary bouncing by penalizing distance from target

components.purpose: Penalize high linear velocities for safe descent
components.expected_effect: Reduces crash risk and encourages controlled landing approach
components.anti_hacking_role: Prevents contact hacking via high-velocity impacts

components.purpose: Encourage upright orientation near pad (state[4] approx 0)
components.expected_effect: Promotes stable landing posture before contact
components.anti_hacking_role: Prevents sideways crashes that trigger leg sensors

components.purpose: Penalize high rotation rates during descent
components.expected_effect: Reduces spinning behavior and improves landing stability
components.anti_hacking_role: Prevents rotational exploitation of termination conditions

components.purpose: Verify ground contact at successful terminations only
components.expected_effect: Confirms physical landing occurred before awarding success bonus
components.anti_hacking_role: Prevents sleep hacking without actual pad contact

components.purpose: Continuous penalty on engine usage (m_power + s_power)
components.expected_effect: Encourages fuel-efficient trajectories per task goal
components.anti_hacking_role: Prevents hovering indefinitely by making flight costly

components.purpose: Large positive reward for verified successful landing at termination
components.expected_effect: Primary success signal distinguishing pad landings from failures
components.anti_hacking_role: Requires position verification to prevent sleep exploitation

components.purpose: Heavy penalty for crash or out-of-bounds termination
components.expected_effect: Strongly discourages failure modes over successful landings
components.anti_hacking_role: Prevents boundary exploitation and crash-based reward maximization
